injuries.longComment: Peavy sat out the Pelicans' Summer League finale, marking his third straight game on the sidelines. The 25-year-old forward averaged 4.3 points in 15.0 minutes per game across 61 regular-season appearances (four starts) in his rookie campaign, and he'll likely continue playing a relatively consistent role off the bench in 2026-27.
injuries.shortComment: Peavy (rest) didn't play in Saturday's 91-73 Summer League loss to the Pacers.
